methods: Activate-labeled forecasts estimate global consumer internet and media revenues for 2017E–2021E; cited inputs include eMarketer, GroupM, IBISWorld, IFPI, the International Monetary Fund, NewZoo, PricewaterhouseCoopers, RBC, the World Bank, and ZenithOptimedia.

The report cites the Activate 2017 Consumer Tech & Media Research Study, with chart-specific sample sizes including n=4,047, n=2,406, and n=996; platform-specific samples are also reported (Facebook n=2,641; Snapchat n=969; YouTube n=2,940).
Top news sites were selected from comScore’s Top 100 digital news properties; figures cover desktop and mobile sites only.

Virtual Pay TV churn covers the trailing twelve months beginning September 2017, while SVOD churn covers calendar year 2016. Programming-cost estimates average base Virtual Pay TV offerings from major services that include broadcast networks and/or sports; estimates account for a premium associated with reduced scale and per-channel costs.
The eCommerce adoption index is based on measured consumer preferences, including preferences measured in the Activate 2017 Consumer Tech & Media Research Study (n=4,047).

For the influencer analysis, the Forbes Top 10 Influencers list was generated with Traackr and Captiv8 using reach, virality, engagement, earnings per post, outside endorsements, and reputation; YouTube channels are counted as unique creators.
